newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech cen bank to drain one-week money at 18.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Czech cen bank to drain one-week money at 18.5 pct.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) said on Friday it would hold a one-week reverse repo tender to drain liquidity at a maximum rate of 18.5 percent, unchanged from a similar tender on Thursday.
The CNB said it would take minimum bids of 100 million crowns before the deadline of 10:20 a.m. (0820 GMT).
The central bank cut its Lombard rate to 23 percent from 50 percent on Thursday.
The CNB has been performing open market operations almost daily in order to regulate liquidity on the market since currency crisis and interest rate hikes in late May.
